page.content:
Imperial aide — Daneel's face in the later books and on Apple.

How Demerzel connects

  • Faction: Galactic Empire — Demerzel serves as the emperor's lasting minister.
  • Series: Foundation (Apple series) — Demerzel is a continuing figure of the Apple series.
  • Character: R. Daneel Olivaw — Demerzel is Daneel's imperial identity.

What is Demerzel?

Demerzel is the emperor's seemingly human minister who the later novels and the Apple series treat as Daneel wearing a courtier's name.

Key threads lead to Galactic Empire, Foundation (Apple series) and R. Daneel Olivaw.
